entries.text: Florida regulates three kinds of in-home provider under Chapter 400, Part III: licensed home health agencies, licensed nurse registries, and registered homemaker/companion service providers.
entries.src: Florida AHCA; Florida Statutes ch. 400 Part III

entries.text: A nurse registry arranges contracts for nurses, aides, homemakers and companions who work as independent contractors, and needs its own AHCA licence (s. 400.506).
entries.src: Florida AHCA, Nurse Registries; s. 400.506 F.S.
entries.note: Caregiver Bench recruits W-2 employees for licensed agencies and places nobody as a contractor. Whether that activity needs any licence is a legal question: get the lawyer's written answer. This is not legal advice.

entries.text: Anyone providing homemaker or companion services must register with AHCA; the registration costs $50.75 for two years and every employee needs background screening. An agency that already holds a home health or nurse registry licence does not need the separate registration.
entries.src: Florida AHCA, Homemaker and Companion Services FAQ; s. 400.509 F.S.

entries.text: Senate Bill 1068 (2026) would add client disclosures and naming and licence-display rules for nurse registries, with 1 July 2026 as its effective date. The Senate page read here showed it at committee stage; a secondary site describes it as in force.
entries.note: Whether it became law was not confirmed on the official site.

entries.text: Florida has about 6,056 in-home care providers, including 2,305 home health agencies (1,154 licensed-only, 1,151 Medicare/Medicaid-certified) and 1,197 nurse registries.
entries.src: Home Care Association of Florida, membership overview
entries.note: A trade association's count; the AHCA facility search is the authority. "Licensed-only" agencies are the closest public proxy for private pay.

entries.text: Home health and personal care aides held about 4.3 million US jobs in 2024; employment is projected to grow 17% from 2024 to 2034, with about 765,800 openings a year. Median pay was $16.78 an hour in May 2024.
entries.src: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Outlook Handbook

entries.text: Median caregiver turnover was 75.5% in 2025, after a peak of 79.2% in 2023.
entries.src: 2026 Activated Insights Benchmarking Report, as cited by HHAeXchange
entries.note: Read through a secondary article. The report itself was not opened.

entries.text: Indeed is a top-two caregiver source for 43.3% of agencies, employee referrals for 15.9%. Agencies whose best source is their own website report the lowest turnover (65.8%).
entries.src: 2026 Activated Insights Benchmarking Report, as cited by HHAeXchange

entries.text: Agencies paying $15–17.99 an hour report median turnover of 84.4%; at $18–19.99 it is 53.0%.
entries.src: 2026 Activated Insights Benchmarking Report, as cited by HHAeXchange
entries.note: Secondary citation. Pay is set by the agency, not by a recruiter: a limit on what recruiting alone can fix.

entries.text: Roughly four in five caregivers who leave do so within their first 100 days.
entries.src: Activated Insights, as cited by several vendor blogs
entries.note: Vendor blog citing the report; wording varies between sources.

entries.text: CareerPlug: applicant-tracking software for home care, the official ATS partner of the Home Care Association of America, used by large franchise brands; integrates with myCNAjobs.
entries.note: Software the agency runs itself. Pricing not found.

entries.text: myCNAjobs: a job network built for caregivers, CNAs and HHAs; says it reaches 5.2 million caregivers.
entries.note: The reach figure is a vendor claim.

entries.text: Augusta: caregiver-recruiting software for home care that matches applicants to agencies and publishes a national recruiting benchmark (120,000+ applicants in Q1 2026); says it has helped hundreds of agencies.
entries.note: Closest to "more applicants reach an interview". Still software, not a done-for-you service with a guarantee. Pricing not found.

entries.text: Hellohire: a recruiting assistant for home care that engages and screens candidates and schedules interviews. Apploi and Hireology: recruiting/ATS platforms used in long-term care and multi-location providers.
entries.note: Third-party descriptions; none of these sites was tested.
